# Pizzeria Concordia

Pizzeria Concordia is a restaurant with two locations in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. Customers can order pizza, pasta, schnitzel and more online for delivery or pickup.

## Locations

- [Concordia Kempen](https://www.concordiapizza.de/branch/concordia-kempen): Concordienplatz 1, 47906 Kempen. Phone +49 2152 9591952. [HTML menu](https://www.concordiapizza.de/kempen-menu.html)
- [Concordia Straelen](https://www.concordiapizza.de/branch/concordia-straelen): Venloer Straße 22, 47638 Straelen. Phone +49 2834 1748. [HTML menu](https://www.concordiapizza.de/straelen-menu.html)
